verdict.rationale: Justworks is a SaaS HR/payroll product with public help docs, so whether it offers llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question. A probe of help.justworks.com/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and no agent-oriented documentation is evidenced. The JSON search endpoint behind the help center is a feature of the help-center hosting platform, not a Justworks agent-docs offering, so it earns no credit.
